title: Diagnostic Charge and Goodwill Authority Rate Card, Workmanship Warranties
content:
Rate card for the plan figures that govern diagnostic charges on warranty inspections under the Workmanship Warranties, and the most the desk may waive of a diagnostic charge as goodwill.

| Figure | Chip Repair Guarantee | Calibration Workmanship Warranty | Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty | Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty | Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Diagnostic charge when an inspection finds a concern of a fee-bearing type not covered (USD; 0.00 means never charged) | 0.00 | 79.95 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 89.95 | 89.95 |
| Concern types on which the diagnostic charge applies when not covered (none means none) | none | calibration fault | none | none | mechanical part, electrical part | mechanical part, electrical part |
| Most the desk may waive of a diagnostic charge as goodwill (USD) | 0.00 | 40.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 45.00 | 45.00 |

## Card notes

- The plan's standard diagnostic fee is the first figure in the card: USD 79.95 under the Calibration Workmanship Warranty, USD 89.95 under the Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty and under the Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty, and 0.00 under the Chip Repair Guarantee, the Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty and the Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty.
- The plan's goodwill authority per charge is the last figure in the card: USD 40 under the Calibration Workmanship Warranty, USD 45 under the Collision Lifetime and Certified Structural Lifetime plans, and 0.00 under the other three plans.
- The fee-bearing concern types are calibration fault under the Calibration Workmanship Warranty, and mechanical part and electrical part under the Collision Lifetime and Certified Structural Lifetime plans; the other plans list none.

Q. What is the goodwill authority per charge on a Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty?
A. USD 45.00.

Q. What is the standard diagnostic fee of the Calibration Workmanship Warranty?
A. USD 79.95.
